name: P17 + P18 — a monster asks to join, you name it, and the whole procession walks on

steps.note: 1. Puddlewick Vale. You are not one boy on a map: Halvard walks behind you and Bobble the Gloop hops after him.

steps.msg: Halvard and Bobble are both walking behind the hero
every follower has a real model, not an empty group
the roster the battle keeps is the roster the field draws

steps.note: 2. Walk up the lane. They follow the path you took, in order, with the wagon rattling along at the back.

steps.assert: (() => { const f = __DQ.state().companions.followers; return f.length < 2 || f[0].gap < f[1].gap; })()
steps.msg: the line is spaced in order — nobody stands inside anybody

steps.assert: (() => { const f = __DQ.state().companions.followers; return f.every(x => x.behind > 0.5 && x.behind < 8); })()
steps.msg: every follower is behind the hero, and none has been left in the last county
the wagon is on the field outdoors

steps.note: 3. Six friends. Four walk, the rest ride: the wagon window shows the whole roster.

steps.msg: four walk at a time, exactly as DQV
the overflow rides in the wagon
the roster window lists everybody, wagon and paddock included

steps.note: 3b. The rules: four walk, order matters, and the two who cannot be sent away stay put.

steps.msg: a guest (Halvard) and the hero cannot be sent to the wagon

steps.assert: (() => { const ids = __DQ.friends().party.map(m => m.id); const back = __DQ.partyOrder(ids.slice().reverse()); return back[0] === 'hero'; })()
steps.msg: order can be set, and the leader is always put back at the front

steps.assert: (() => { const w = __DQ.friends().wagon[0]; const r = __DQ.partySwap('bobble', w.id); return r.ok === true && __DQ.friends().party.map(m => m.id).indexOf(w.id) >= 0; })()
steps.msg: a monster in the wagon can be swapped into the walking four

steps.note: 4. The signature beat: a Cactuddle asks to be your friend, and you give it a name.

steps.msg: the name field is pre-filled with the bible default (Cactuddle -> Prickle): confirm twice and a child has a friend
the join was recorded
Prickle is in the roster under the name you kept

steps.note: 5. Too many friends for one wagon: the rest wait in the paddock at Hollybank, and you can see them there.

steps.msg: beyond four walking and eight riding, a friend waits in the paddock
the paddock monsters are actually drawn in the village
in the village the wagon is parked at its spot on the lane

steps.note: 5b. The paddock itself: friends hopping about in the fenced field behind Hollybank Cottage.
5c. Talk to the one walking behind you: everybody in the line has something to say.

7. THE REAL PATH: win a fight, and the Gloop you beat asks to come along. The join question is P14's; the naming, the paddock overflow and the new follower are P17's, hung off the battle.end event so no shared file had to change.

steps.msg: the Gloop we beat is the one asking
the fight produced a real, named friend

steps.note: 8. It saves. The paddock and the order the party stands in go through Save.register under the key 'friends', so a child who turns the machine off still has their monsters.

steps.eval: (() => { const p = __DQ.friends().paddock.length, w = __DQ.friends().wagon.length; __DQ.partyMove(__DQ.friends().party[3].id, 'paddock'); return JSON.stringify({wasPaddock: p, wasWagon: w, nowParty: __DQ.friends().party.length}); })()

steps.msg: a saved game comes back with the paddock and the four walkers intact
the friend named after the fight is still in the roster after a save and a load

steps.note: 6. Nothing broken: no console errors, the frame is still moving.

steps.msg: no runtime errors
the procession does not cost the frame rate
